name: Haskell
description: Haskell is a purely functional programming language with strong static typing and lazy evaluation. It provides an unparalleled foundation for writing correct, composable, and concurrent software. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Learn You a Haskell for Great Good!
items.description: The iconic beginner-friendly classic teaching functional programming from basic syntax to monads with a humorous, illustrated approach.

items.title: Haskell Programming from First Principles
items.description: The most thorough book for mastering Haskell from scratch. Free chapters and community solutions available via GitHub.

items.title: Haskell.org Documentation Hub
items.description: Central hub for official guides, the Haskell Report, language standards, and library documentation via Hackage.

items.title: Hackage — Haskell Package Repository
items.description: Central package repository with complete API documentation for thousands of Haskell libraries.

items.title: GHC Users Guide
items.description: Complete documentation for the Glasgow Haskell Compiler covering language extensions, optimization, and profiling.

items.title: Haskell MOOC (University of Helsinki)
items.description: A premier free interactive course split into two parts covering from basics to algebraic data types and monads.

items.title: Type Classes Free Crash Courses
items.description: Professional-grade visual courses and free introductory tracks tailored for programmers entering the Haskell ecosystem.

items.title: Haskell for Imperative Programmers (YouTube)
items.description: A comprehensive video series teaching Haskell from an imperative programming background with clear explanations.

items.title: Tsoding — Haskell Live Coding
items.description: Live coding sessions exploring Haskell, functional design patterns, and real-world applications.

items.title: Exercism — Haskell Track
items.description: 107 free exercises with community volunteer mentors who review your code for idiomatic functional style.

items.title: Codewars — Haskell Kata
items.description: Over 2,100 community-driven coding katas from beginner to advanced algorithms.

items.title: Haskell Cheatsheet (GitHub)
items.description: Comprehensive reference sheet with syntax, keywords, operators, pattern matching, and type declarations.

items.title: Hoogle — Haskell API Search
items.description: Search Haskell functions by name or type signature. Find standard library and package functions instantly.

items.title: Haskell Weekly
items.description: Weekly curated newsletter and podcast covering library releases, blog posts, tutorials, and success stories.

items.title: GHC Release Notes
items.description: Track GHC compiler releases, language extension proposals, and performance improvements.

items.title: Haskell Discourse
items.description: Official community forum with a dedicated learning category for beginners to ask questions and get help.

items.title: Reddit r/haskell
items.description: Vibrant community sharing announcements, blog posts, project showcases, and deep FP discussions.

items.title: Haskell.org Community
items.description: Official community page listing user groups, IRC channels, mailing lists, and global Haskell events.
